{{Quote|I am Victor Strang. ''[&hellip;]'' This is my ship. You're not taking her from me.|Admiral Strang, to Renegade Squadron|<ref name="Light">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
'''Victor Strang''' was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and a former [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was given command of a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]-equipped [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] named the [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Admiral Strang? Victor Strang? He's the captain? He used to lead a team of Storm Commandos. Stay sharp, men. This will be no ordinary boarding action.|[[Col Serra]] as Renegade Squadron approaches the ''Conqueror''|<ref name="Light" />}}
Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Strang was in command of a team of [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]], elite troopers of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. Later in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]], he was promoted to the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] and placed in command of the [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']], an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] equipped with a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]. He encountered the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] led by [[Col Serra]] when they [[Mission to Mustafar (Renegade Squadron)|infiltrated]] the ''Conqueror'' in the [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Strang and his storm commandos were defeated by the Renegades, who proceeded to place [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] on the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]]. The detonators were triggered and the ship was destroyed, but before the explosion an [[X4 Gunship/Legends|X4 Gunship]] was able to escape from the ''Conqueror''. One of the Renegades speculated that this ship may have been carrying Strang.<ref name="Light" />
